g.title: seq
g.text: 06b Competitive bidding under the New Government Procurement Act (RA 12009): who does what, with the time limits

a.text: 1. Requesting office to BAC and procurement
unit: Purchase request, specifications,
bidding documents for an item in the Annual
Procurement Plan
2. BAC and procurement unit to Budget unit:
Are appropriations available for this
procurement?
3. Budget unit to BAC and procurement unit:
Confirmation: the item is in the budget law,
or in the proposed budget for early
procurement
4. BAC and procurement unit: Pre-procurement
conference: the procurement follows the plan,
appropriations are available, the award
criterion is chosen
5. BAC and procurement unit to PhilGEPS
(modernized): Post the invitation to bid and
the bidding documents, with the budget for the
contract and the source of funding. Also on
the website of the entity, and 7 days at its
premises
6. PhilGEPS (modernized) to Suppliers and
payees: Notice visible to registered suppliers
7. BAC and procurement unit to Suppliers and
payees: Pre-bid conference, at least 12 days
before the deadline for bids (required from a
budget of PHP 3 million)
8. Suppliers and payees to BAC and procurement
unit: Bids in two sealed envelopes: technical
(with eligibility documents and bid security)
and financial. Deadline: at most 45 days
(goods), 50 or 65 (works), 75 (consulting)
after posting
9. BAC and procurement unit to Observers:
Invitation to observe each stage: at least two
observers, in addition to the representative
of COA
10. BAC and procurement unit: Opening of bids
immediately after the deadline. Each envelope
passes or fails. A bid above the approved
budget for the contract is rejected
11. BAC and procurement unit: Bid evaluation:
7 days for the lowest calculated bid, 14 days
when quality is rated with price, 21 days for
consulting. Rank by the award criterion

a.xlink:title: enter: Until one bidder passes, starting from the first in rank

a.text: 13. BAC and procurement unit to Head of
agency: Recommendation of award, with the
document that authorizes the entity to incur
the obligation
12. BAC and procurement unit to Suppliers and
payees: Post-qualification within 12 days:
verify the legal, technical and financial
documents, with the latest tax returns
14. Head of agency to Suppliers and payees:
Approval within 10 days, then the notice of
award immediately
15. Head of agency to PhilGEPS (modernized):
Award published
16. Suppliers and payees to Head of agency:
Performance security, before signing: 5
percent (goods, consulting) or 10 percent
(works) of the contract price, 30 percent as a
surety bond
17. Head of agency to Suppliers and payees:
Contract signed within 10 days from receipt of
the notice of award
18. Head of agency to Suppliers and payees:
Notice to proceed within 3 days from approval
of the contract
19. Observers to Head of agency: Observation
report (also to PhilGEPS, and copies to the
GPPB and the Ombudsman)
20. Observers to COA: Observation report
21. Suppliers and payees to BAC and
procurement unit: Request for reconsideration
within 3 days. The BAC decides within 7 days
22. Suppliers and payees to Head of agency:
Protest within 7 days, filed electronically,
with a fee that is not returned. Decision
within 7 days. It is final for smaller
contracts. For the others: review by the
Regional Trial Court

a.xlink:title: end of: A losing bidder objects
